# Cache design exploration (generated by scripts/cache_summary.py)

Workload: chained ResNet-18 W8A8 inference, ONE image, every data load/store of the 37 ops (verification code excluded), cold cache at start, write-back + write-allocate. Instruction fetches are not modelled. Simulator validated against Spike `--dc` (identical counts, see EXPERIMENTS.md).

Workload instruction counts: B1 7.540 G, X1 1.169 G, X1T 1.159 G.

## Does the cache erase the ISA gain? (instruction-count model + miss model)

Same program, same cache, B1 (scalar) vs X1 (qmac8+qreq) vs X1T (X1, cache-blocked). `ideal` = no misses = pure instruction ratio. Misses are nearly the same absolute number for B1 and X1 (the same bytes are touched), but X1 retires ~6.5x fewer instructions, so its misses per instruction (MPKI) are ~6.5x higher.

| cache | LAT | B1 CPI | X1 CPI | B1->X1 | X1T CPI | B1->X1T |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 4K-4w-64B-plru | 10 | 1.091 | 1.573 | 4.47x | 1.474 | 4.81x |
| 4K-4w-64B-plru | 40 | 1.243 | 2.529 | 3.17x | 2.265 | 3.57x |
| 16K-4w-64B-plru | 10 | 1.066 | 1.430 | 4.81x | 1.179 | 5.88x |
| 16K-4w-64B-plru | 40 | 1.177 | 2.148 | 3.53x | 1.478 | 5.18x |
| 64K-4w-64B-plru | 10 | 1.046 | 1.300 | 5.19x | 1.142 | 5.96x |
| 64K-4w-64B-plru | 40 | 1.124 | 1.799 | 4.03x | 1.379 | 5.30x |

ideal (no misses): B1->X1 = 6.45x, B1->X1T = 6.50x.

## Workload sensitivity of the replacement policy

Spread = (worst - best) / best miss count over {LRU, PLRU, FIFO, RANDOM} at the same geometry. A policy matters only if the spread is large.

| geometry | workload | best | worst | spread |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
